name: manual_221ecd
claim: When exact Mac queue task IDs are absent from every local replica, publish exact-ID GossipBus claims and a LAN notice instead of creating duplicate local queue rows.

decisions.notes: Observed 2026-11-28: both local boards and the local queue replica lacked the Mac rows; duplicate queue creation would have fragmented ownership.

rationale: Observed 2026-11-28: both local boards and the local queue replica lacked the Mac rows; duplicate queue creation would have fragmented ownership.
